This modules provides a simplified access to a dsp402 enabled device.

= Configuration =

 - name: my_dsp402
   so_file: libmodule_dsp402.so
   config: 
     devices:
       - name: wheel_left
         pdin: ecat.slave_1.inputs.pd
         pdout: ecat.slave_1.outputs.pd
         state_word_offset: 0
         control_word_offset: 0
     TODO
   power_up: op
